prompt: Photorealistic studio product rendering of 20mm robot fingertip tactile cartridge in operating moment, sectioned close-up isometric side view with slight vertical exploded gaps for visibility but preserving functional touching order. On plain seamless light-grey studio backdrop with soft product lighting. Bottom: small dark rigid finger holder block cut off cleanly at backdrop, stiff light-grey rigid mounting core bolted to it with two small vertical metal screws. Exactly two flat rigid horizontal green PCBs total in whole stack, both perfectly flat and unb bent: large lower readout board about 0.8x stack width with chips on rigid core, and thin upper taxel electrode board above it. Single soft-pillar array ONLY: one dense array of tiny translucent rounded vertical silicone pillars 1-2mm tall between electrode PCB and film above; absolutely no metal pins, no silver-black shafts, no second array. Exactly one thin translucent vibration film ONLY directly under skin and above soft pillars; no second membrane under electrode board. Full-width matte grey ridged silicone touch skin cap with same footprint as boards covering entire top of stack, not a small disc. An adult human index fingertip presses center of ridged skin for scale showing whole device about 20mm across, only skin and upper film dent in center, central pillars compressed more than outer, both green PCBs stay perfectly flat rigid horizontal. Thin flat flexible orange-brown rear tail stays visibly connected exiting rear edge of lower readout board and looping back. Show clean legible callouts on small light tags in empty space with thin leader lines and no other text: Ridged Touch Skin leader to grey cap edge, Vibration Sensing Film leader to translucent layer directly under skin, Soft Pillar Array leader to translucent pillars, Taxel Electrode Board leader must land on edge of flat green upper electrode PCB never on pillars pins or membranes, Readout Circuit Board leader to lower green board edge, Rigid Mounting Core leader to grey block, Flexible Rear Tail leader to orange tail, no margins or scale bars. Real materials, sharp focus, mechanism readable.
must_not: metal pins or telescopic shafts or second pillar array
third or middle circuit board or wavy bent boards
second membrane or film under electrode board
small isolated disc cap narrower than stack
numbers symbols or extra words on callout tags
room landscape sky furniture tools clutter or extra people
